content: If yu nomo teiknodis wen sambodi kipgon dalimbat yu, yu dumbat rong ting, wal wandei yu garra ardim miselp en faindim miselp langa bigis trabul.
Wen det boswan blanga eni kantri gibit im pipul feyago ebribodi jidan brabli gudbinjiwei, bat wen det boswan nomo gibit im pipul feyago wal ola pipul jidan nogudbinji.

If yu laigim det brabli sabibalawei, yu dedi en mami garra gudbinji langa yu brabliwei, bat if yu yusum mani blanga detlot wuman blanga silipsilipbat garram olabat, yu garra jidan nomo garram enijing.
If det king im bos trubalawei en gibit feyago langa ebribodi im garra meigim im kantri jidan brabli strongbala, bat if im wandim gajimbat mani nogudbalawei im garra binijimap im kantri.
Enibodi hu oldei preisimbat sambodi laiyinbalawei garra trepam im ronselp.
Detlot pipul hu dumbat ola nogudbala ting garra trepam olabat selp garram olabat nogudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu dumbat ola rait ting garra sing song gudbinjiwei.
Ola gudbala pipul sabi hau blanga tridim detlot po pipul en gibit olabat feyago, bat detlot wikitwan pipul nomo sabi hau blanga albumbat po pipul raitwei.
Pipul hu mokimbat pipul meigim trabul langa taun, bat pipul hu jinggabat gudwei gin meigim pipul hu oldei agamin gija jidan kwaitbala.
Eni sabibala men kaan deigim silibala men langa kot. Im kaan win. Det silibala men garra oni laf langa im en meigimbat mowa trabul.
Detlot men hu oldei medrimbat enibodi nomo laigim enibodi hu jidan trubalawei en dumbat ola rait ting.
Nomo jidan silibala en git brabli wail kwikbala. Yu garra jinggabat gudwei en jidan kwaitbalawei.
If det boswan teiknodis langa ola laiyinbala wed, wal ol im wekinmen olabat garra jidan wikitwan du.
Detlot powan pipul en detlot pipul hu tridimbat olabat krulbalawei, YAWEI det trubala God garra tridim olabat seimwei. Imbin gibit olabat dubala ai blanga luk.
Det king hu gibit feyago langa ola po pipul garra kipgon jidan king longtaim.
If yu lenim en streitinimap yu biginini raitwei, im garra jidan sabibala. If yu libum im blanga dum wanim im wandim, bambai im garra meigim im mami brabli nogudbinji.
Wen wikitwan pipul jidan bos, loda brabli nogudbala ting garra hepin, bat detlot pipul hu dumbat rait ting garra luk detlot wikitwan pipul garra binij.
If yu garra lenim en streitinimap yu biginini olabat raitwei dei garra kain langa yu en meigim yu jidan gudbinji.
Detlot pipul hu jidan langa olabat kantri en nomo teiknodis langa det lowa blanga God garra abum loda trabul, bat detlot pipul hu kipgon det lowa blanga God im tok garra jidan hepiwan.
Nomeda detlot wekinmen jidan sabiwan, bat stil yu garra dum mowa den jis tok blanga meigim olabat duwit.
If sambodi jidan silibala maitbi sambodi gin album im, bat det sambodi hu tok kwikbala en nomo jinggabat bifo im tok, wal nobodi kaan album im.
If yu tridim yu wekinmen hu jidan laiga prisana kainbalawei brom wen imbin yangbala biginini, im garra gibit yu trabul bambai.
Sambodi hu oldei gitwail kwikbala meigimbat loda trabul, en im na dumbat loda nogudbala ting.
If enibodi jidanbat praudbalawei im garra sheim miselp brabliwei, bat if enibodi meigim miselp lobala im garra abum rispek brom pipul.
If yu albumbat sambodi stilimbat enijing, yu garra jidan yu ronwan enami, dumaji yu kaan tok trubalawei wen yu go langa kothaus.
Yu nomo bradin blanga wanim najalot pipul tok blanga yu. Yu trastim YAWEI en yu garra jidan seifwan.
Loda pipul oldei wandim meigim fren langa olabat bos, bat oni YAWEI na gibit ebribodi feyago.
Detlot gudbala pipul nomo laigim detlot wikitwan pipul en detlot wikitwan pipul nomo laigim detlot gudbala pipul.
